# ControllersInput

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/generic_input.h`](../../../src/logic/player/generic_input.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

Unity's MultiControllerInput: a gamepad.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `connected` | `bool` | a gamepad is there |
| `left_stick` | `glm::vec2` | x right, y forward |
| `right_stick` | `glm::vec2` | x right, y up |
| `left_trigger` | `float` | 0..1 |
| `right_trigger` | `float` | 0..1 |
| `a` | `bool` | A |
| `x` | `bool` | X |
| `left_shoulder` | `bool` | left shoulder |
| `dpad` | `float` | +1 the frame up is pressed, -1 down |
| `deadzone` | `float` | stick dead zone (0.2) |
| `last_action` | `double` | (GenericPlayerInput) s of play of the last use |

## Notes

Left stick walks, right looks (rate), A jumps, right trigger primary, left secondary, X interacts, left shoulder runs, d-pad control; active when connected. Written by the viewer's ControllersInput system.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[ControllersInput](../systems/ControllersInput.md)**
  - SDL_InitSubSystem(SDL_INIT_GAMECONTROLLER) in preinit (not in captures and probes), SDL_QuitSubSystem in finish.
  - Looks for a gamepad every second while none is open (SDL_GameControllerOpen), closes it when detached and in finish.
- **[Hold](../systems/Hold.md)**
  - Narrow phase ray cast of `reach` along the view on a press of interact.
  - Sets the collision group of the held body; clears it and, on a throw, sets its linear velocity when it is dropped.
  - Adds and removes BodyDrive components (BodyDrives makes the constraint).
- **[LookTurn](../systems/LookTurn.md)**
  - None.
- **[MountSteering](../systems/MountSteering.md)**
  - None.
- **[Mounting](../systems/Mounting.md)**
  - `CollideShape` of the player's capsule, at its place and 0.6 m lower, with max separation `reach`, on a press of jump when not riding.
  - Sets the collision group of the ridden animal's collider; clears it 0.6 s after getting off.
  - On a jump off: `SetLinearVelocity` of the player (the saddle's velocity plus `hop` m/s to the animal's left and 1 m/s up).
- **[PlayerLegs](../systems/PlayerLegs.md)**
  - At each 60 Hz physics step (FixedSteps.before): a narrow phase ray cast per player, `AddForce` of the stand, walk and jump forces, `ActivateBody`.
  - Sets the collision group of the player's body once (`SetCollisionGroup`).
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[VRBody](../systems/VRBody.md)**
  - Teleports the player's Jolt body by the head's motion each frame (`BodyInterface::SetPosition`, activated).
